prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a person’s hand holding a smartphone, with their thumb poised above the screen in the act of interacting with a food delivery app. The phone’s display is sharply in focus, showing a modern, clean user interface with Cyrillic text and vibrant food images—one of which features a colorful dish, possibly noodles or salad, and another menu item below. The dominant colors on the screen are white, green, and touches of orange and brown from the food photos. The thumb and fingers are rendered in natural, warm skin tones, with soft, directional lighting that creates gentle highlights and shadows, emphasizing the texture of the skin and the glossy surface of the phone. The background is dark and blurred, creating a shallow depth of field that isolates the hand and phone, lending an intimate, immersive feel. The overall style is realistic and contemporary, with a slight cinematic quality reminiscent of a commercial or lifestyle film, focusing on the tactile, everyday moment of ordering food via a mobile app.
